papers.title: Green Light: Carbon-Aware Design of Photonic Transformer Accelerators at the Edge
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.27376v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Migrating transformer inference to the edge requires sustainability considerations that encompass both operation and manufacturing, rather than operational energy alone. Silicon photonics enables high-bandwidth, low-energy matrix multiplication; however, existing microring-resonator-based Dot Product Unit (DPU) organizations have been tailored to convolutional computations and evaluated using analog signaling without accounting for embodied carbon footprints. We adapt three DPU organizations (AMW, MAW, and MWA) to transformer inference workloads and extend each organization to stochastic signaling, yielding six organizations in total.
